title: TDD gate: mandatory testing before merge

comments.author: cli
comments.body: ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ADDENDUM (2026-10-26). Merge gate: main does not receive the ticket engine until all of the following pass in a clean clone on the Docker-capable VM from ticket #35: npm ci && npm test (120 tests), ticket-engine validate exits 0, npm run build succeeds, and the end-to-end smoke run (./lab <disposable-workspace> --unsafe-recurse -> create/update a ticket -> ./lab stop) succeeds. The gate must be a committed script/CI job, not a manual checklist.

comments.author: migration
comments.body: Structured acceptance criteria and test ledger backfilled from the 2026-10-26 acceptance-criteria addendum. The original addendum above is retained as history; the structured fields are now the source of truth.

acceptance_criteria.text: In a clean clone on the Docker-capable VM from #35, npm ci && npm test is green for the full Jest suite.
The ticket-engine validate command exits 0 in that clean clone.
npm run build succeeds in that clean clone.
The end-to-end smoke run succeeds: ./lab <disposable-workspace> --unsafe-recurse -> create/update a ticket -> ./lab stop.
The merge gate is a committed script or CI job, not a manual checklist.

needed: clean-clone npm ci + npm test job
